lines: Inside time that knows no stopping
I watched street after street
as they changed before my eyes
The face of a dream that vanished too young, never to return
I saw it overlaid on a boy passing by
Wanting everything there was
innocently enough to betray people
Even the one a friend I understood had loved
I couldn't make amends
Still carrying the pain today
I run on with all I have, and yet
tomorrow is still out of sight
with neither victory nor defeat
this lonely race goes on
People are creatures who forget
to an almost sad degree
The joy of being loved, the lonely past
To move forward from here
there's no way around conflict
And that is how the world
keeps turning today
Beyond the endless dark
Oh oh, let's reach out our hands
Even if I try living for someone else
Oh oh tomorrow never knows
As my heart is, I go on
toward a tomorrow no one can know, woo woo
Kindness alone isn't enough to live on
Some have chosen to part
We'll meet again someday
somewhere along this long journey
Beyond the endless dark
Oh oh, let's reach out our hands
If the pain will never heal
then let me carry it along
It's fine to lose my way a little
Oh oh, let's sketch a dream
Even if I tried living for someone else
Oh oh tomorrow never knows
As my heart is, I go on
toward a tomorrow no one can know, woo woo, oh oh oh oh
